Gulf shrimp, crab and grouper straight off the boats — the Destin Seafood Festival runs Sep 25–27 along the harbor boardwalk, about a 35-minute drive west.

Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27, two nights.

Harbor by day, three king bedrooms and deep quiet by night.

Tap the link in bio to book direct.

#SunAndMoon30A #StayWithTheSky #30Aliving #Seaside30A #Seagrove #EmeraldCoast #DestinSeafoodFestival #30ARentals

The Destin Seafood Festival takes over the harbor boardwalk Sep 25–27 — free to attend, 75+ vendors, five music stages, and Saturday closing under fireworks, about a 35-minute drive west of us. Blue Moon is open Sat Sep 26 – Sun 27 (2 nights), so you can spend the day on the harbor and come home to a quiet lane in Seagrove, three minutes from the beach walkover. Live dates and instant confirmation at https://book.sunandmoon30a.com
